en: Jātaka: The Second Book of Birth Stories (Dukanipāta),
3. The Cūḷapaduma Jātaka: “This is she and I am he, no other;
this is that very one with severed hands, no other.”
As for what he said, “She is my mistress from her youth,” there is no truth among women, O Vajjī;
having struck this wretch with a pestle, [he shall be killed].
“Cut off the ears and nose of this woman who is a wicked wife, a hunter,
and one who consorts with another’s husband while he is still alive.”
